The candidate must have a proven ability to learn quickly and leverage ServiceNow to solve real world problems and design solutions to promote security automation and process improvement.

• Supports Service Now team to design and mature CMDB, ITSM, and other modules by organizing and applying updated policy and workflows.

jobs.title: Event Management ServiceNow ITOM Developer
jobs.description:
Job Number: R0249186

Event Management ServiceNow ITOM Developer

The Opportunity:

Are you looking for an opportunity to combine hands-on development with big picture thinking to make an impact on the services people rely on every day? You understand that detecting a problem is only the beginning, and that the difficult work is getting it to the right owner with enough context to act on — or resolving it without interrupting anyone at all. As a ServiceNow ITOM developer on our team, you'll own the layer where monitoring signal becomes action. Your customers will trust you not only to build and tune Event Management — connectors, event rules, correlation and grouping logic, and alert-to-incident automation — but to evolve it, moving event classes from human-handled to fully automated one at a time, each with the verification, rollback, and evidence to demonstrate it is safe. On our team, you'll broaden into ITOM, CSDM, and agentic operations. This is a hands-on development role. You'll write and review code, and what you build will act on production systems. Due to the nature of work performed within this facility, U.S. citizenship is required.

What You'll Work On:

• Build and tune ServiceNow Event Management, including connectors, event rules, correlation and grouping logic, aggregation, and alert-to-incident automation.
• Normalize severity and event fields across monitoring sources so that every alert arrives on one consistent, ITIL-aligned scale.
• Engineer entity-to-CI binding accuracy, partnering with CMDB owners on identification, reconciliation, and CSDM alignment where binding breaks.
• Develop automated and agentic remediation with bounded blast radius, approval gates, verification that the service recovered, rollback, and a complete evidence trail.
• Integrate monitoring platforms with ServiceNow through REST, IntegrationHub, and Flow Designer, and keep those integrations stable through platform upgrades.
• Move event classes from human-handled to automated one at a time, and prove each one with evidence that holds up under audit.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:

• 5+ years of experience in ServiceNow development, including workflows, forms, UI policies, business rules, and integrations
• Experience working in Scrum or SAFe
• Experience with JavaScript, the Glide API, and Python or a language for data transformation and automation, and with event management concepts including deduplication, correlation, alert grouping, and threshold design
• Experience integrating monitoring or third-party systems using REST or SOAP APIs, including MID Server configuration and troubleshooting, and knowledge of CMDB structure and CSDM
• Experience building automation with explicit safety design, including approvals, verification, and rollback
• Ability to run root cause analysis on detection gaps and false positives, tracing a bad alert from source event through rule evaluation to the record it created
• Bachelor's degree in a CS or Information Systems field
• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

Nice If You Have:

• Experience delivering a ServiceNow Event Management implementation end to end
• Experience with Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, and Service Portal development
• Experience with ITOM Discovery and Service Mapping in depth, including custom pattern development and CMDB health remediation
• Experience integrating a major monitoring platform as an event source
• Experience with Now Assist or ServiceNow agentic capability, or with ServiceNow in a DoD or accredited environment
• ServiceNow CIS — Event Management, CIS — Discovery, CIS — ITOM, Certified Application Developer (CAD), or ITIL v4 certification

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $86,800.00 to $198,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

• Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
• Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently, in alignment with leadership expectations and the needs of the role. You may also be required to work from or visit a customer facility.
• Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.

Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

In the digital economy, it takes more than good ideas and strong leadership to thrive. Upgrading outdated processes, systems and information is vital – but can be a risky investment in such a rapidly changing environment. That’s why some of the most prestigious businesses worldwide look to us for authoritative, agile, and efficient solutions for business decision-making. As a ServiceNow Senior Consultant you’ll play a leading role in that mission, providing the competitive edge our clients need to overcome some of the biggest creative and technical challenges around.

The opportunity

You’ll lead ServiceNow Transformation teams in a rapidly growing area of the business. It’s a client visible role, in which you’ll have opportunities to showcase your ability to not only motivate and develop your team but also establish and maintain new client relationships. You will have an opportunity to grow your consulting and team leadership skills, as well build relationships and obtain experiences that will define your career.

As a Senior Technology Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will interact with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring that newly implemented technology solutions meet their needs. Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will spend your time engaging with clients and internal teams to ensure successful project delivery. You will face challenges that require analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, providing you with opportunities to learn and grow in a dynamic environment. This position may require regular travel to meet with clients, allowing you to build relationships and understand their needs better. Key responsibilities include:

• Interacting with business stakeholders to evaluate business models and processes.
• Analyzing newly implemented technology solutions to verify they meet business requirements.
• Collaborating with technical teams to design and deliver system architecture solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Here, you’ll serve a wide portfolio of clients - each with their own backgrounds, strengths, and ambitions, so no two days will be the same. That could mean working to improve our customers’ ITSM processes (e.g., Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Service Catalog, Knowledge Management) or evaluating how AI can streamline delivery. Wherever you find yourself, you’ll be making a visible impact on projects that cross borders and challenge conventional wisdom to encourage transformation.

• Act as a workstream lead across all aspects of a ServiceNow ITSM project and solution delivery including but not limited to design, configuration/development, testing and deployment phases
• Ability to manage and mentor a multi-disciplinary team of 3-5 resources including offshore resources (e.g., consultants, developers, and testers)
• Provide guidance and industry leading practice expertise for ServiceNow ITSM process implementations, including how specific business objectives can be met through process and technology transformation
• Ability to analyze a company’s people, process, and technology capabilities, provide leading practice recommendations and contribute insights to strategic roadmaps
• Ability to advise on the connectivity of the CMDB and IT Operations Management (ITOM) to ITSM processes
• Current knowledge of ServiceNow AI capabilities for ITSM, including Now Assist, Virtual Agent, Predictive Intelligence, AI Search, AI Agents, and AI Control Tower
• Ability to identify and advise clients on practical AI-enabled ITSM use cases, including incident triage, ticket summarization, knowledge recommendations, self-service automation, and service desk productivity
• Ability to translate ServiceNow AI capabilities into measurable business outcomes, including faster resolution, improved employee experience, reduced manual effort, and stronger service operations
• Ability to lead client process and design sessions and facilitate requirements workshops with functional and/or business process area subject matter resources
• Experience in waterfall and agile delivery models – including supporting management activities such as planning, status reporting, budgets and risk and issue logs
• Ability to create high quality deliverables and project artifacts

To qualify for the role, you must have

• A bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Systems Management, Engineering or similar discipline
• Typically, no less than 2 - 4 years relevant ServiceNow ITSM project experience
• ServiceNow Certified Systems Administrator (CSA) or Certified Application Developer (CAD)
• Minimum of 1 of the following ServiceNow certifications:
• ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – ITSM
• 3+ years of Big 4 or equivalent consulting experience
• Excellent soft skills – communication (written/verbal), adaptability, problem solving, teamwork, relationship building, dependability, and organization
• Experience leading teams and supervising others
• A driver’s license valid in the U.S.
• Ability to travel to meet client needs

Ideally, you’ll also have

• ServiceNow Certified Master Architect (CMA) or Certified Technical Architect (CTA)
• Performance analytics and reporting experience – certifications are a plus
• ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Data Foundations or HAM or SAM
• Experience in ServiceNow’s AI solutions (e.g., Now Assist, Agentic, AI Control Tower)

What We Look For

We seek individuals who are proactive, innovative, and eager to contribute to team success. Top performers are those who demonstrate strong analytical skills, the ability to communicate effectively, and a passion for technology and its impact on business.

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

• We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $102,500 to $187,900. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $122,900 to $213,400. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
• Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
• Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Description

Leidos is seeking an experienced ServiceNow SAM Developer to join our Strategic Operations Project Team that is chartered to transition AFDW ITSM BMC Helix to ServiceNow.

As a ServiceNow Developer, you will be the hands-on engineering force behind the IT Service Management (ITSM) modernization efforts for the Air Force District of Washington (AFDW) and the Department of the Air Force (DAF). Working in close coordination with architects and business stakeholders, you will build, configure, and deploy the automated workflows, custom applications, and system integrations that replace legacy, siloed processes. Your ability to write clean code, establish modern API integrations, and leverage ServiceNow out-of-the-box capabilities is vital to delivering secure, efficient, and user-centric solutions that directly support DAF mission readiness and day-to-day operations.

The Challenge:
• SAM & ITAM Module Engineering.

jobs.description:
Overview

Empower AI is AI for government. Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation. Headquartered in Reston, Va., Empower AI leverages three decades of experience solving complex challenges in Health, Defense, and Civilian missions. Our proven Empower AI Platform® provides a practical, sustainable path for clients to achieve transformation that is true to who they are, what they do, how they work, with the resources they have. The result is a government workforce that is exponentially more creative and productive. For more information, visit www.Empower.ai .

Empower AI is proud to be recognized as a 2024 Military Friendly Employer by Viqtory, the publisher of G.I. Jobs. This designation reflects the company’s commitment to hiring and supporting active-duty and veteran employees.

Responsibilities

Empower AI is seeking a ServiceNow Platform Architect at the subject matter expert level to own the technical architecture of the enterprise IT Service Management platform for a Department of War agency and to shape how the service desk, AI-enabled Tier 0, Service Portal, Service Catalog, CMDB, knowledge management, and the Customer Support Metrics Dashboard fit together on and around ServiceNow. Working in a shared environment where a Government platform owner controls administrative rights and production deployment, the Architect defines platform standards, integration patterns, security and ATO alignment, and the technical roadmap; leads architecture for Virtual Agent, AI Ops, Predictive Intelligence, and Active Directory orchestration; evaluates emerging capabilities through proofs of concept; and provides senior technical leadership to ServiceNow developers, administrators, and integration developers. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

THIS IS AN ONSITE ROLE IN QUANTICO, VA (RKB) WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

JOB DUTIES:

• Define and maintain the ServiceNow platform architecture, development standards, instance strategy, integration patterns ( IntegrationHub , REST/SOAP, LDAP/AD, event sources), and security/ATO alignment for the Government's ITSM platform, in coordination with the Government platform owner.
• Lead architecture and technical direction for AI-enabled capabilities on the platform (Virtual Agent, AI Ops, Predictive Intelligence, Now Assist, Active Directory orchestration) and for the Service Portal, Service Catalog, CMDB, knowledge management, and dashboard integrations.
• Review and approve solution designs, update sets, and application packages from ServiceNow developers and administrators for architectural integrity, performance, upgradeability, secure coding, and supportability before delivery to the platform owner.
• Lead platform proofs of concept, market research, and ROMs for new ServiceNow capabilities and modules, author POC and Market Research Reports, and provide expert technical analysis for IT Capability Requests affecting the platform.
• Define and maintain the target-state solution architecture for integrated customer support services, spanning the ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow), AI-enabled Tier 0 (Virtual Agent, AI Ops, Active Directory orchestration), endpoint infrastructure, collaboration and web platforms, communications, knowledge management, and the Customer Support Metrics Dashboard (Power BI with Active Directory integration).
• Lead architecture and technical direction for AI, automation, and advanced analytics initiatives, including predictive analytics on service data, intelligent automation across support tiers, and chatbot/virtual agent capabilities, ensuring designs are feasible , secure, and approved by the Government before implementation.
• Architect the Digital Twin capability for network and system modeling and the practice of testing significant changes in a digital replica, and contribute to the Digital Twin Evaluation and Implementation Plan.
• Provide expert technical analysis for IT Capability Requests: requirements elicitation, business process and gap analysis, solution alternatives, market research, and ROMs, and prepare briefing materials for Program Management Reviews and agency governance boards.

Qualifications

REQUIREMENTS :

• Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 15 years of related experience (a Master's degree with 12 years of related experience may be substituted).
• Must be a U.S. Citizen.
• Must have an Active Top Secret Clearance with SCI eligibility (favorably adjudicated T5/T5R) to start.
• Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting.
• Must possess and maintain a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level III baseline certification (e.g., CASP+ CE, CISSP or Associate, CCNP Security, GCED, or GCIH).
• Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision.
• Minimum of 15 years of progressive IT experience, including at least 5 years as a solutions or enterprise architect for large, multi-site IT service delivery or infrastructure programs.
• Expert-level knowledge of enterprise ITSM platforms (e.g., ServiceNow architecture, integrations, AI Ops/Virtual Agent), endpoint management, Microsoft 365/Power Platform, and Power BI analytics architecture.
• Demonstrated experience architecting AI/ML, automation, or advanced analytics solutions for IT operations and customer support.
• Demonstrated experience developing solution alternatives, business cases, cost-benefit analyses, ROMs, and executive briefings for Government or enterprise decision-makers .
• Extensive experience designing solutions that meet DoD cybersecurity requirements (RMF, DISA STIGs/SRGs, Zero Trust) and achieving ATO.
• Experience leading and mentoring multidisciplinary technical teams and reviewing engineering artifacts.
• Excellent technical writing, briefing, and stakeholder engagement skills, including with senior Government executives.

DESIRED SKILLS:

• ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or Certified Master Architect; multiple Certified Implementation Specialist certifications (ITSM, CSM, ITOM, HRSD).
• TOGAF, Zachman, or DoDAF architecture certification; ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect or Certified Implementation Specialist; AWS/Azure Solutions Architect; CISSP or CASP+ CE.
• Experience supporting Department of War ( DoW ), DoD, or Intelligence Community environments across NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves.
• Experience with ISO/IEC 20000-1 service management systems and ITIL 4 (Managing Professional or Strategic Leader).
• Experience with Technology Business Management (TBM), DoD 5000 Adaptive Acquisition Framework, and DoDI 8115.02 IT portfolio management.
• Experience architecting digital twin or network modeling capabilities.
• PMP or SAFe Architect certification.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

The physical demands described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to do the following:

• Communicate verbally and respond to verbal communications in person and over the phone.
• Communicate clearly and succinctly in writing, primarily utilizing a keyboard.
• Engage in intermittent physical activity, including bending, reaching, lifting, filing, and prolonged periods of sitting.
• Travel minimally, via car or plane, which requires ability to manage luggage, laptop, and briefing materials (up to 25 pounds).

About Empower AI

All hiring and promotion decisions at Empower AI are based on merit to bring the best talent available to contribute to our firm’s overall success. It is the policy of Empower AI not to discriminate against any applicant for employment, or employee because of age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, or veteran status. jobs.title: ServiceNow Lead Architect
jobs.description:
We are seeking a hands-on ServiceNow Claims Lead Engineer to serve as the technical subject matter expert (SME) for a highly customized specialty claims platform built on ServiceNow.

This role is focused on architecture, design, and hands-on development, working closely with engineering leadership, product stakeholders, and a Software Integrator (SI) to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions.

The platform leverages ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM), App Engine, and Integration Hub with extensive scripted customizations and complex integrations across policy administration, financial systems, and enterprise data platforms.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building and evolving complex platforms, staying close to the code, and acting as the go-to technical authority for ServiceNow architecture and implementation.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Architecture & Technical Ownership

• Serve as the ServiceNow technical authority (SME) for the claims platform.
• Design and evolve claims data models, workflows, case structures, and automation to support complex business processes.
• Architect solutions using CSM and App Engine to enable highly customized, non–out-of-the-box functionality.
• Define and maintain technical standards, patterns, and best practices for the platform.
• Ensure architectural decisions balance flexibility, performance, maintainability, and long-term scalability.

Hands-On Development & Solution Design

• Actively contribute to development, including ServiceNow scripting (JavaScript, Script Includes, Business Rules, UI logic).
• Build prototypes, reference implementations, and reusable components.
• Review and guide implementation work delivered by internal engineers and the SI.
• Lead technical design sessions and provide clear direction on solution approaches.
• Drive consistency and reuse across platform components.

Integration & Data Architecture

• Design and implement integrations using ServiceNow Integration Hub, including custom actions and orchestration.
• Build and support both:
• Real-time transactional integrations
• Batch-based data pipelines
• Integrate with:
• Policy administration systems
• Financial and accounting platforms
• Enterprise data warehouse / analytics systems
• Apply strong understanding of:
• Synchronous vs. asynchronous processing
• Data consistency and reliability across distributed systems

SDLC & Platform Quality

• Contribute to and help enforce SDLC practices, including design standards, code quality, and release processes.
• Support platform stability through involvement in production support, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
• Ensure solutions are built with operational readiness, observability, and performance in mind.
• Continuously identify opportunities to improve platform quality, maintainability, and developer experience.

Collaboration & Technical Partnership

• Partner closely with engineering leadership, product teams, and the SI to translate business needs into technical solutions.
• Act as a trusted technical advisor across engineering and business stakeholders.
• Mentor developers on ServiceNow best practices and architectural patterns.

The above cited duties and responsibilities describe the general nature and level of work performed by people assigned to the job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all the duties and responsibilities that an incumbent may be expected or asked to perform

Required Qualifications

• 8+ years of software engineering experience with strong hands-on ServiceNow development.
• Deep experience with:
• ServiceNow CSM
• App Engine (custom applications)
• Integration Hub (custom actions and orchestration)
• Proven experience working in heavily customized ServiceNow environments with significant scripted logic.
• Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise integrations and data pipelines.
• Solid understanding of:
• Event-driven architecture
• Sync vs. async integration patterns
• Distributed data consistency
• Ability to contribute directly to code and guide implementation teams.
• Strong communication skills and ability to influence technical decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience building or supporting financial or insurance domains
• ServiceNow certifications (CSA, CAD, CIS-CSM) preferred but not required.
• Experience operating in regulated or compliance-driven environments.

jobs.title: Enterprise - ServiceNow SAM Technical Consultant
jobs.description:
Who You'll Work With:

As a modern technology company, our Slalom Technologists are disrupting the market and bringing to life the art of the possible for our clients. We have passion for building strategies, solutions, and creative products to help our clients solve their most complex and interesting business problems. We surround our technologists with interesting challenges, innovative minds, and emerging technologies.

Title: Enterprise - ServiceNow SAM Technical Consultant

What You'll Do:

As a ServiceNow Software Asset Management Technical Consultant, you will serve as the hands-on builder on ServiceNow Software Asset Management (SAM) engagements and pre-sales activities across the software entitlement and spend landscape, including software entitlement and license management, discovery and normalization, license position and reclamation, SaaS License Management, engineering and clinical software models, and audit readiness. You will own configuration, development, and integration work, translating requirements and user stories into working platform solutions. You will engage confidently with both business and technology stakeholders, demonstrating high technical proficiency, professional maturity, and executive presence. This is a techno-functional role, and you bring enough process and requirements depth to flex when an engagement calls for it, stepping in occasionally to gather requirements, write stories, or back up the business process consultant on a short-term basis.
• Configure and develop ServiceNow SAM solutions spanning entitlement capture, effective license position calculation, reclamation and true-up cycles, audit readiness, and renewal planning
• Build and extend platform functionality, including Flow Designer flows, subflows and actions, UI Builder and Workspace configuration, forms, business rules, client scripts, script includes, ACLs, and Performance Analytics content
• Build SAM technical configuration, including software discovery models and normalization rules, license metric definitions, entitlement imports, reclamation and true-up automation, SaaS integrations, and effective license position calculations
• Design and build integrations between ServiceNow and adjacent enterprise systems using REST and SOAP, IntegrationHub spokes, MID Server, transform maps, and scheduled data imports
• Own technical design artifacts, including technical specifications, data models, integration designs, and configuration workbooks
• Participate in discovery and design workshops to gather and analyze business requirements, and translate them into well-formed epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria when an engagement calls for it
• Create, refine, and manage stories in the delivery backlog, estimating effort, grooming with the team, and keeping sprint commitments and dependencies visible
• Ensure solutions align to leading practices and out-of-the-box capabilities, challenging customization requests with configuration-first alternatives
• Apply platform delivery discipline across scoped applications, update set and pipeline hygiene, peer code review, unit testing, and the Automated Test Framework (ATF)
• Support testing cycles, defect triage and remediation, deployment readiness, cutover, and post-go-live hypercare
• Advise clients on technical debt, upgrade readiness, platform performance, and long-term maintainability of the build
• Mentor teammates on configuration, scripting, integration patterns, and technical delivery best practices, and on requirements analysis and story writing
• Respond to Requests for Information and Proposals (RFIs/RFPs) with authoritative ServiceNow technical content, build approaches, and estimation inputs
• Contribute to practice development through reusable components, delivery accelerators, technical playbooks, thought leadership, and ServiceNow-focused client offerings

What You'll Bring:

You are a seasoned ServiceNow technical consultant who thrives in complex enterprise environments and has a track record of building and delivering transformational ServiceNow implementations. Your strength is configuration, development, and integration, complemented by enough process and requirements fluency to step into functional work when a project needs it.
• 3+ years of ServiceNow configuration and development experience, with deep expertise in at least one of Software Asset Management, SaaS License Management, IT Asset Management, or software licensing and compliance advisory
• Strong hands-on skills across server-side and client-side scripting (JavaScript, GlideRecord, GlideAjax, script includes), Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, UI Builder, scoped applications, and platform security
• Passion for leveraging the ServiceNow platform to streamline software asset operations, improve software asset manager and procurement experiences, and bring visibility and control to software entitlement, consumption, and spend across the estate
• Experience gathering and analyzing business requirements and writing well-formed user stories and acceptance criteria, enough to backstop a business process consultant on discovery and backlog work
• Ability to communicate and build relationships at all levels of an organization, from software asset managers and platform teams to VP of Procurement, CIO, CFO, and C-suite executives, translating technical and business concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences
• Strong problem-solving and debugging ability, with the capacity to diagnose complex platform issues, manage client expectations, and deliver on tight schedules with high attention to detail
• Experience delivering solutions across multiple ServiceNow products, including technical design, build, integration, testing, deployment, and hypercare
• Enough process and functional fluency across software licensing, entitlement management, and audit readiness to facilitate a requirements or design session when needed; deep process specialization is not expected
• Experience participating in practitioner workshops focused on solution design, technical architecture decisions, and backlog refinement

Qualifications:

At least 3 full-lifecycle ServiceNow implementations in a technical consultant, hands-on configuration and development, or technical lead capacity

REQUIRED CERTIFICATIONS
• Certified System Administrator (CSA)
• CIS – Software Asset Management (CIS-SAM)

PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS
• CIS – Data Foundations (CIS-DF)
• CIS – Hardware Asset Management (CIS-HAM)
• Certified Application Developer (CAD)
• CIS – IT Service Management (CIS-ITSM)

Technical & Platform Expertise
• Strong technical knowledge of the ServiceNow platform (Software Asset Management Pro, software models and entitlements, discovery and normalization, license metric definitions, reclamation rules, SaaS License Management, Flow Designer, scoped applications, and Reporting/Performance Analytics)
• Experience with Hardware Asset Management, Enterprise Asset Management, and Source-to-Pay Operations big plus
• Working knowledge of major publisher licensing models (Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, IBM, Adobe, Salesforce) and the data quality work behind a defensible effective license position
• Experience building integrations between ServiceNow and adjacent enterprise systems such as SaaS management platforms, endpoint and discovery tools, procurement and contract repositories, ERP and financial systems, and publisher entitlement portals
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to business stakeholders
• Working knowledge of requirements elicitation, backlog management, and agile ceremonies sufficient to support functional workstreams
• Experience with source control, CI/CD pipelines, update set and application repository management, and the Automated Test Framework (ATF)
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and professional experience preferred

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer - ServiceNow
jobs.description:
Job Title: ServiceNow UI/UX Designer

Location: Washington, DC 20003 (Onsite)

Duration: 6 Months Contract (with possible extension)

Interview type: In-person interview

Description:

The client is seeking an ServiceNow UI/UX Designer to lead the design and enhancement of user-centered digital experiences across the client's ServiceNow platform. This role will collaborate with business stakeholders, developers, and end users to create intuitive, accessible, and visually engaging solutions that improve service delivery for District employees, businesses, and residents while ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, accessibility requirements, and ServiceNow best practices.

Responsibilities:

-Design end-to-end user experiences for ServiceNow modules, portals, and Employee/Customer Workspaces, including wireframes, user flows, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity visual designs.

-Partner with business analysts, ServiceNow developers, and agency stakeholders to translate functional requirements into intuitive, accessible interface designs.

-Conduct user research, usability testing, and stakeholder interviews to inform design decisions and validate solutions with real end users (District employees, businesses, and residents).

-Build and maintain design systems, style guides, and reusable UI components consistent with ServiceNow's Now Design System and DC government branding/accessibility standards.

-Design and configure Service Portal widgets, UI Builder pages, and Now Experience components, ensuring designs are technically feasible within platform constraints.

-Ensure all designs meet Section 508 / WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards and are tested for compliance.

-Collaborate with ServiceNow developers/administrators during build and QA phases to ensure design fidelity is preserved through implementation.

-Create and maintain UX documentation, including personas, journey maps, information architecture diagrams, and design specifications.

-Present design concepts and rationale to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including agency leadership.

-Stay current on ServiceNow platform releases (ex: new Now Experience UI Builder capabilities) and recommend design improvements accordingly.

-Support change management and training efforts by producing clear visual documentation of new interfaces and workflows.

Minimum Qualifications

-Bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

-Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in UI/UX design, with demonstrated experience designing for enterprise software platforms.

-At least 4 years of hands-on experience designing within or for the ServiceNow platform (Service Portal, UI Builder/Now Experience, Workspaces, or Virtual Agent interfaces).

-Proficiency with industry-standard design and prototyping tools (ex. Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch).

-Solid understanding of user-centered design methodology, including user research, journey mapping, wireframing, and usability testing.

-Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript sufficient to collaborate effectively with ServiceNow developers and customize Service Portal widgets.

-Demonstrated experience designing for accessibility (Section 508/WCAG 2.1 AA).

-Strong portfolio showcasing enterprise UX/UI work, including before/after examples or platform-specific projects where possible.

-Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present and defend design decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences..

Preferred Qualifications:

-ServiceNow certifications such as Certified System Administrator (CSA) or Certified Application Developer (CAD).

-Experience working within a government or public-sector IT environment.

-Familiarity with the ServiceNow Now Design System component library.

-Experience with Agile/Scrum development environments and tools such as Jira or ServiceNow Agile Development.

-Prior experience conducting design work under public-sector procurement, security, or compliance requirements (e.g., FISMA, NIST).

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

-Strong visual design sensibility paired with practical understanding of enterprise platform constraints.

-Ability to balance user needs, business requirements, and technical feasibility.

-Skilled at synthesizing feedback from multiple stakeholders into cohesive design solutions.

-Detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple design projects concurrently.

-Comfortable working in a fast-paced, mission-driven government environment.

jobs.description:
job description:

at bank of america, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. we do this by driving responsible growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

being a great place to work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive responsible growth. we are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. this includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates' physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.

we value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. these journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.

bank of america is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

at bank of america, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. join us!

location: sydney, australia

job description:
cyber threat intelligence (cti) works with partners, both internal and external, to reduce risk to the firm and to the financial sector at large. stakeholders include cyber-security response teams, internal lines of business, senior leadership and external organizations such as law enforcement, industry peers, key suppliers, customers and intelligence sharing partners. the cyber threat intelligence (cti) triage team is responsible for receiving, documenting, assessing risk, and if required, escalating all incoming cyber threat information.

the cti triage analyst is responsible for responsible for providing timely situational awareness, monitor a wide variety of sources, looking for indications and warnings of threats and attacks. the cti triage analyst rapidly translates indicators of threat into actionable information to help reduce the potential impact to the operations of the business. this is an opportunity to work with a best in class global enterprise team. the candidate will have exposure to the latest developments in technology and latest threats.

responsibilities:

  • work in a tactical/technical role reviewing and cultivating intelligence sources, analyzing information, creating intelligence, and hunting for exposures or related incidents.
  • participate with other triage analysts in a follow-the-sun model to provide consistent support for cyber security operations. this will encompass weekend shift work on a rota basis.
  • contribute to daily internal gis ops calls, contribute to intelligence briefings for senior leaders.
  • work within the ctoc communicating with internal teams and minimizing response times for critical events.
  • identify, escalate and debate recommended actions that strengthen controls.
  • operate within an established escalation matrix to determine report priority and messaging to operations and senior executives throughout gis and the lines of business, escalate issues to control teams and management in a timely manner with appropriate information regarding risk and impact.
  • continually and consistently review triage processes to identify reforms that could add to increased speed, efficiency and accuracy in reporting.
  • exercise independent judgment in methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results.
  • participate in technical bridge lines to facilitate the identification, mitigation and containment of cyber-security incidents.

skills:

  • 5+ years of infosec experience. this is a hands-on role where the candidate will be involved in identifying and tracking cyber threats on a daily basis.
  • the candidate should exhibit a firm understanding of the cyber threat landscape, geopolitical issues that could have cyber impacts, security vulnerabilities, exploits, malware, digital forensics, network security vulnerabilities, exploits and attacks.
  • experience with threat intelligence platforms, tools, and threat intelligence vendors.
  • experience supporting or contributing to incident response or major security investigations.
  • experience with jira/servicenow, python, and other programming languages will be a strong plus.
  • experience working in a security operations, incident management or fusion center operation.
  • minimum 1 year working in a 24/5 or 24/7 operational environment.
  • this position requires strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • bachelor's degree or higher-level education is a strong plus.
  • technical or information security certifications are also a strong plus.

This role will play a critical hands-on role in configuring, maintaining, and evolving ServiceNow to support district-wide business processes across multiple modules, including—but not limited to— Source-to-Pay (S2P), Human Resources Service Delivery (HRSD), IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Asset Management (ITAM), and other modules. The ideal candidate brings strong platform fundamentals, experience supporting enterprise workflows, and the ability to partner effectively with non-technical stakeholders across a large public-sector organization. The ServiceNow Application Developer will ensure solutions are scalable, user-centered, secure, and aligned to DCPS operational priorities, while supporting continuous improvement of service delivery across central office and school-based teams.

Essential Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain technical documentation, including configuration details, process flows, and user guidance.

• Partner closely with internal IT teams, vendors, and ServiceNow partners as appropriate.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• Five or more years of hands-on ServiceNow administration experience, including

• Ownership or co-ownership of a ServiceNow instance.

• Forms, lists, tables, and dictionary configuration

• Update sets and platform administration

jobs.title: ServiceNow IRM Pro / GRC Architect-level Consultant
jobs.description:
Description

ServiceNow IRM Pro / GRC architect-level Consultant

Skills

Architecture, consultant, ServiceNow IRM Pro / GRC architect-level Consultant, Solution architecture, Enterprise architecture

Top Skills Details

Architecture,consultant,ServiceNow IRM Pro / GRC architect-level Consultant,Solution architecture

Additional Skills & Qualifications

The right person should have strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow IRM Pro, specifically around the relationships between risks, issues, controls, control objectives, policies/standards, exceptions, approvals, owners, expiration dates, and reporting. The customer already has ServiceNow platform knowledge available, so this person does not need to be the only technical platform resource in the room. What they do need is deeper IRM/GRC expertise and the ability to translate business risk and compliance requirements into a practical ServiceNow design.

A Few Things I Would Add To The Profile

• ServiceNow IRM Pro / GRC architect-level experience, not just general ServiceNow administration
• Post-implementation recovery or reset experience where the tool was implemented but adoption/process did not land
• Ability to assess current-state IRM configuration and recommend a practical crawl/walk/run path
• Strong understanding of risk, issue, exception, policy/standard, and control relationships within IRM
• Experience designing exception workflows, including approval paths, expiration dates, owner assignment, and control linkage
• Ability to help define a minimum viable control structure for exceptions without forcing a full control-library rollout on day one
• Strong facilitation skills with customer risk/compliance leaders
• Ability to create clear deliverables: refined scope, milestone plan, backlog/user stories, workflow recommendations, training/adoption plan, and handoff documentation
• Comfortable working with a customer SME who is IRM/GRC certified and will be heavily involved in validating the approach
• Remote is fine, but the person should be able to come onsite in DC occasionally if needed for key working sessions

Expected duration is probably 8 weeks to start, with possible extension based on what we find during the initial assessment and reset planning.

The main thing: we are not looking for someone who can simply train users on the existing configuration

Expert Level

This is a Contract position based out of Washington, DC.

jobs.title: Senior ServiceNow Developer - Public Trust Clearance
jobs.description:
LightFeather is seeking a highly skilled Senior ServiceNow Developer to play a critical role in designing, developing, and deploying ServiceNow solutions for federal government projects. This role requires deep technical expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to drive the successful implementation of ServiceNow applications while ensuring optimal performance, security, and scalability. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in ServiceNow platform architecture, development, integrations, and workflow automation, along with the ability to lead teams in an Agile environment. This is a Full Time, Remote Position.

• Location: Fully Remote (EST hours)
• Job Type: Full-time
• Salary: $90,000–$115,000 annually, based on experience
• Clearance Requirement: U.S. citizenship is required for this position due to federal contract requirements and the need to obtain and maintain a Public Trust level security clearance

Responsibilities:

• Lead the design, configuration, development, and deployment of ServiceNow applications, ensuring alignment with business requirements and industry best practices.
• Develop, customize, and enhance ServiceNow modules, including but not limited to ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, App Engine, and Service Portal.
• Create and manage complex workflows, business rules, UI policies, ACLs, and automation scripts using JavaScript, GlideScript, and Flow Designer.

• Lead integration efforts with external systems using REST APIs, SOAP APIs, MID Server, Integration Hub, and third-party connectors.
• Ensure platform security, compliance, and best practices, including role-based access controls (RBAC) and data governance policies.
• Mentor and lead a team of ServiceNow developers, providing guidance, technical oversight, and best practices for efficient solution delivery.
• Collaborate with stakeholders and business analysts to translate requirements into scalable, maintainable ServiceNow solutions.
• Troubleshoot and resolve platform issues, optimize system performance, and conduct root cause analysis.
• Work within an Agile framework (Scrum/Kanban), participating in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and daily stand-ups.
• Document technical solutions, workflows, and architecture designs for internal knowledge sharing and client handover.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

• Active DHS Public Trust clearance or higher.
• 9+ years of hands-on experience with ServiceNow platform development and administration.
• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
• Strong expertise in ServiceNow App Engine and custom application development.
• Advanced knowledge of ServiceNow Service Portal Development, including widget customization and UI scripting.
• Experience integrating ServiceNow with external systems using REST, SOAP, and third-party APIs.
• Proven ability to lead development teams and ensure efficient, high-quality solution delivery.
• Experience working in Agile environments with tools like Jira or Azure DevOps.
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices for ServiceNow application deployment.
• Experience working with Amazon Web Services (AWS).
• Strong scripting skills in JavaScript, GlideScript, and Flow Designer.
• Excellent communication skills with the ability to present technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with experience managing development teams.
• Exceptional problem-solving, analytical thinking, and troubleshooting abilities.
• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
• Conflict resolution expertise to mitigate risks and ensure project success.

Preferred:

• Experience with HR Service Delivery (HRSD) solutions within ServiceNow.
• Deep expertise in ServiceNow platform architecture and solution design.
• Experience with scripting languages such as JavaScript, GlideScript, and UI policies/business rules.
• Proficiency in designing and implementing complex integrations using Integration Hub and external APIs.

At LightFeather, you're not just taking a job—you're joining a purpose-driven team that delivers innovative, mission-critical solutions to make a real difference. You'll work on diverse, meaningful projects that challenge and inspire you, alongside some of the best minds in the industry.

jobs.description:
Job Description
The selected resource must support, optimize, and expand configurations across all currently implemented modules , including:
ITSM - Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Service Catalog and Knowledge Management
CSM - Customer Service Management and Employee Service Portal
CMDB - Configuration Management Database
HAM - Hardware Asset Management

Primary Responsibilities
• Solution Design & Analysis: Work closely with business stakeholders to understand their requirements and design easy-to-use solutions. Analyze complex business problems and translate them into technical designs that fully leverage platform capabilities.
• Platform Configuration: Customize and configure applications using built-in features such as UI policies, business rules, data policies, and client scripts. Prioritize ServiceNow out-of-the-box (OOTB) functionality, modifying it only as necessary to meet specific campus requirements.
• System Integration: Design and implement robust integrations using web services, APIs, and other methods—specifically REST, SOAP, or MID Server - to connect ServiceNow with external institutional systems and ensure seamless data flow.
• Best Practices & Governance: Follow development best practices, adhere to coding standards, and follow governance guidelines. Maintain rigorous documentation of all technical designs, development activities, and configuration changes.
• Roadmap, Prototyping & Estimation: Partner with leadership to drive toward the implementation of the platform roadmap. Demonstrate platform capabilities to show stakeholders what is possible/recommended, rapidly prototype new solutions, and reliably estimate work effort to enable proper team prioritization.
• Platform Health: Ensure overall ServiceNow availability via good design, thorough testing, and responsiveness in root cause analysis. Stay updated with the latest features, releases, and industry trends to recommend and implement continuous improvements.

Required Experience:
• Higher Education Industry Experience — Required
• 5+ years of experience administering or developing within a large-scale implementation of ServiceNow — Required

Required Certifications:
• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) — Required

Technical Skills:
• Platform Scripting: Deep proficiency in JavaScript, the ServiceNow Glide API (GlideRecord, GlideSystem, GlideAjax), Business Rules, UI Actions, Client Scripts, Script Includes, and UI Policies.
• Workflow Automation: Advanced expertise in building complex logic using Flow Designer, Workflow Editor, and IntegrationHub.
• User Interface & Experience: Strong front-end development skills using HTML, CSS, and AngularJS to configure, customize, and build custom widgets within the Service Portal / Employee Center.
• Integration Frameworks: Proven experience designing and configuring data integrations via REST and SOAP web services, JSON, XML, Import Sets, Transform Maps, and MID Server configurations.
• Data & Configuration Architecture: Robust understanding of database design, CMDB class hierarchies, and Hardware Asset Lifecycle configurations.
• Application Lifecycle & Governance: Expertise in managing code deployment using Update Sets (cloning, conflict resolution, migration paths), App Engine Studio, and adhering to strict ServiceNow development guardrails to preserve platform upgradability.

jobs.description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

In the digital economy, it takes more than good ideas and strong leadership to thrive. Upgrading outdated processes, systems and information is vital – but can be a risky investment in such a rapidly changing environment. That’s why some of the most prestigious businesses worldwide look to us for authoritative, agile, and efficient solutions for business decision-making. As a ServiceNow Senior Consultant you’ll play a leading role in that mission, providing the competitive edge our clients need to overcome some of the biggest creative and technical challenges around.

The opportunity

You’ll lead ServiceNow Transformation teams in a rapidly growing area of the business. It’s a client visible role, in which you’ll have opportunities to showcase your ability to not only motivate and develop your team but also establish and maintain new client relationships. You will have an opportunity to grow your consulting and team leadership skills, as well build relationships and obtain experiences that will define your career.

As a Senior Technology Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will interact with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring that newly implemented technology solutions meet their needs. Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will spend your time engaging with clients and internal teams to ensure successful project delivery. You will face challenges that require analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, providing you with opportunities to learn and grow in a dynamic environment. This position may require regular travel to meet with clients, allowing you to build relationships and understand their needs better. Key responsibilities include:

• Interacting with business stakeholders to evaluate business models and processes.
• Analyzing newly implemented technology solutions to verify they meet business requirements.
• Collaborating with technical teams to design and deliver system architecture solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Here, you’ll serve a wide portfolio of clients - each with their own backgrounds, strengths, and ambitions, so no two days will be the same. That could mean working to improve our customers’ HRSD process or evaluating how AI can streamline delivery. Wherever you find yourself, you’ll be making a visible impact on projects that cross borders and challenge conventional wisdom to encourage transformation.

• Act as a workstream lead across all aspects of a ServiceNow HRSD project and solution delivery including but not limited to design, configuration/development, testing and deployment phases
• Ability to manage and mentor a multi-disciplinary team of 3-5 resources including offshore resources (e.g., consultants, developers, and testers)
• Provide guidance and industry leading practice expertise for ServiceNow HRSD process implementations, including how specific business objectives can be met through process and technology transformation
• Demonstrated knowledge of ServiceNow’s latest AI-enabled HRSD and employee experience capabilities, including Now Assist for HRSD, EmployeeWorks, and Employee Slate, and how they can improve employee self-service, HR case resolution, onboarding, and lifecycle event delivery
• Experience shaping AI-enabled HRSD use cases that leverage EmployeeWorks as a conversational AI front door and Employee Slate as a personalized employee experience layer to help employees find answers, complete requests, manage tasks, and engage with HR services through natural language
• Ability to advise clients on responsible AI adoption in HRSD, including governance, data and knowledge readiness, security/privacy, workflow design, human-in-the-loop controls, adoption strategy, and value measurement
• Ability to analyze a company’s people, process, and technology capabilities, provide leading practice recommendations and contribute insights to strategic roadmaps
• Ability to lead client process and design sessions and facilitate requirements workshops with functional and/or business process area subject matter resources
• Experience in waterfall and agile delivery models – including supporting management activities such as planning, status reporting, budgets and risk and issue logs
• Ability to create high quality deliverables and project artifacts

To qualify for the role, you must have

• A bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Systems Management, Engineering or similar discipline
• Typically, no less than 2 - 4 years relevant ServiceNow HRSD project experience
• ServiceNow Certified Systems Administrator (CSA) or Certified Application Developer (CAD)
• Minimum of 1 of the following ServiceNow certifications:
• ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – HR Service Delivery
• 3+ years of Big 4 or equivalent consulting experience
• Excellent soft skills – communication (written/verbal), adaptability, problem solving, teamwork, relationship building, dependability, and organization
• Experience leading teams and supervising others
• A driver’s license valid in the U.S.
• Ability to travel to meet client needs

Ideally, you’ll also have

• ServiceNow Certified Master Architect (CMA) or Certified Technical Architect (CTA)
• Performance analytics and reporting experience – certifications are a plus
• Employee Center and Workplace Service Delivery experience – certifications are a plus
• Experience in ServiceNow’s AI solutions (Now Assist, Agentic, AI Control Tower)

What We Look For

We seek individuals who are proactive, innovative, and eager to contribute to team success. Top performers are those who demonstrate strong analytical skills, the ability to communicate effectively, and a passion for technology and its impact on business.

What We Offer You

seeking a full-time ServiceNow Application Developer to support the development, administration, and ongoing enhancement of the district's ServiceNow platform within the Office of Data & Technology.
This role will play a critical hands-on role in configuring, maintaining, and evolving ServiceNow to support district-wide business processes across multiple modules, including-but not limited to- Source-to-Pay (S2P), Human Resources Service Delivery (HRSD), IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Asset Management (ITAM), and other modules. The ideal candidate brings strong platform fundamentals, experience supporting enterprise workflows, and the ability to partner effectively with non-technical stakeholders across a large public-sector organization. The ServiceNow Application Developer will ensure solutions are scalable, user-centered, secure, and aligned to DCPS operational priorities, while supporting continuous improvement of service delivery across central office and school-based teams.

Essential Responsibilities
The ServiceNow Application Developer will:
• Serve as a primary administrator for the ServiceNow instance, supporting day-to-day service operations and maintenance.
• Configure and maintain ServiceNow applications, including forms, lists, workflows/flows, notifications and reporting.
• Support development and enhancement activities across multiple ServiceNow modules, including ITSM, HRSD, S2P, and other modules available.
• Design and maintain Service Catalog items and end-to-end workflows using Flow Designer, approvals, task routing, and notifications.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, translate business needs into technical solutions, and recommend platform-aligned approaches.
• Ensure configurations follow ServiceNow best practices, prioritizing configuration over customization and maintaining upgrade readiness.
• Troubleshoot platform issues, resolve defects, and support continuous improvement through analysis and refinement of existing processes.
• Develop and maintain technical documentation, including configuration details, process flows, and user guidance.
• Partner closely with internal IT teams, vendors, and ServiceNow partners as appropriate.

Minimum Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• Five or more years of hands-on ServiceNow administration experience, including
• Ownership or co-ownership of a ServiceNow instance.
• Strong foundational knowledge of the ServiceNow platform, including:
• Forms, lists, tables, and dictionary configuration
• Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and UI Actions
• Roles and Access Control Lists (ACLs)
• Update sets and platform administration
• Proficiency in JavaScript for ServiceNow scripting (business rules, client scripts, UI policies)
• Demonstrated experience integrating ServiceNow with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs
• ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent ITSM process knowledge

Preferred Qualifications
• ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) preferred
• Experience with one or more ServiceNow application areas such as ITSM, HRSD, S2P, CSM, or SecOps.
• Experience building or supporting system integrations using REST APIs, Integration Hub, and data imports.
• Experience working in a public sector, K 12, education, or other highly regulated environment

jobs.description:
AT&T Global Public Sector is a trusted provider of secure, IP enabled, cloud-based, network solutions and professional services to the Federal Government. We are dedicated to recruiting, developing and empowering a diverse, high-performing workforce that is passionate about what they do, committed to our shared values and dedicated to our customers’ mission.

and collaboration services for the full spectrum of operations.

AT&T has an opening for an NMS ServiceNow Senior Software Designer: To support a key program in AT&T’s National Security business segment. The NMS IT Software Designer will provide expert knowledge of network management systems, operating systems, commercial software, government software, and full integration of toolsets and servers. This position requires office presence a minimum of 5 days per week and is only located in the location(s) posted. No relocation is offered.

Description of Job Duties/Responsibilities:
• Compliance with Department of Defense (DoD) 8140.03 (8570) Information Assurance Technical (IAT) Level 2.
• Oversee and guide team members in the deployment, administration, development, and integration of the ServiceNow suite of tools on RHEL and Windows operating systems, while facilitating collaboration with database developers on MariaDB requirements.
• Lead the team in utilizing Agile, Scrum, and SDLC methodologies to coordinate, track, and deliver projects efficiently, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.
• Coordinate closely with Project Managers and Technical Leads, ensuring clear communication of team progress, risks, and technical challenges.
• Direct integration efforts with Cisco Network Services Orchestrator, GOTS, and other enterprise tools, assigning integration tasks and ensuring successful outcomes.
• Oversee the creation and maintenance of technical documentation by the team, ensuring accuracy and completeness for operations users and providing user handoff training as needed.
• Monitor the team’s efforts to maintain IT system and application performance/availability while responding proactively to emerging issues.
• Lead the team in hardening and securing systems, supporting Risk Management Framework (RMF) authorization and accreditation (A&A) efforts, and ensuring all engineered solutions are compliant.
• Guide the automation and orchestration of ServiceNow deployment activities using modern tools and methods (Ansible, Python, Terraform, PowerShell), and mentor the team in best practices for testing, validation, and verification.
• Manage the troubleshooting, diagnosis, and resolution of complex system and service issues, overseeing Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and driving continuous improvement.
• Direct system performance analysis and tuning activities, ensuring solutions are efficiently configured and optimized by the team.
• Lead engineering projects and technical processes through the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC), ensuring the team meets deliverables, achieves positive outcomes, and stays within scope and budget.
• Oversee the delivery of well-developed and engineered solutions as deployable packages, ensuring Operations teams can transition solutions to production environments with minimal manual intervention and high success rates.
• Perform additional duties as assigned and needed in a dynamic environment to support evolving business and technical requirements.

Required Clearance: TS/SCI with polygraph. (#ts/sci) (#polygraph)

Required Qualifications: Candidate must have 16 years of experience that can be a combination of work history and education. This equates to a doctorate and 8 years of experience OR a master’s and 10 years OR a bachelor’s and 12 years OR an associate’s and 14 years OR HS and 16 years. Must meet Information Assurance Technical (IAT) Level 2 certification requirements. Additional requirements include:
• Must have at least 5 years of relevant ServiceNow experience that can be a combination of work history, education, and training.
• Must have Certification: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator.
• Must have at least one other advanced ServiceNow certification.
• Team Leadership experience.
• The candidate must be highly motivated. Able to work independently with both local and geographically diverse team members. Using effective time management skills to meet deliverable timelines.
• The candidate must also have experience working within concept, design, engineering, production, and sustainment phases of ServiceNow system development lifecycle.
• Experience with at least one of (Agile, Scrum, SDLC).
• Must be able to work with minimal supervision to perform complex technical tasks and lead others effectively.
• Must be able to process and analyze information and trouble calls submitted by a customer (e.g., system administrator, developer, security specialist), make determinations, and provide and implement solutions.
• Proven experience automating the implementation and configuration of ServiceNow technologies to support large scale enterprise solution deployments and configuration management efforts.
• Hands-on experience with developing, evaluating, assessing, and refining automated testing, validation, and verifications methods.
• Excellent client-facing and internal communication skills.
• Exceptional organizational skills, including attention to detail, multitasking and critical thinking skills.
• Skilled in working within a team environment within a professional office setting.
• Skilled in the ability to focus study and research to rapidly solve specific problems.
• Excellent and clear written documentation skills.
• Excellent self-study to achieve advanced training as required by the team and the program.
• Thrive within a highly dynamic and changing environment while adapting and managing shifting customer priorities.
• Excellent verbal communication skills.
• Working knowledge of Service Now or other ITSM.
• Experience working with Microsoft Office products: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
• Experience innovating in a collaborative environment.
• Advanced system architecture, design, and integration.
• Experience with databases. Ideally including MariaDB.
• Required Cross platform and integration experience including Windows, Linux, Juniper, and Cisco.
• Demonstrated experience developing and scripting within ServiceNow using languages such as JavaScript, as well as integrating ServiceNow with external systems using Java, Python, Perl, or PowerShell.

Desired Qualifications:
• CompTIA Security+ or equivalent will meet the minimum requirement for the role.
• ISC2 CISSP or equivalent is strongly preferred and exceeds the minimum requirement for this role.
